item.title: Assam DCs Asked to Fix Fish Prices, Form Monitoring Panels Ahead of Magh Bihu
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Fisheries Department has directed all Deputy Commissioners (DCs) across Assam to take urgent steps to regulate retail fish prices ahead of Magh Bihu, to be celebrated from next Tuesday, and to constitute district-level monitoring committees to prevent abnormal price hikes during the festive season. item.title: Russell Peters to Perform in Shillong on March 27 as Part of 2026 India Tour
item.description: GUWAHATI: Shillong is set to welcome one of the biggest names in global stand-up comedy, as Russell Peters brings his Relax World Tour to Meghalaya on March 27, 2026. The Canadian comedian’s Shillong show is part of his much-anticipated return to India, marking his sixth tour of the country. item.description: GUWAHATI: In view of the prevailing cold weather conditions across Kamrup (Metropolitan) district, the District Elementary Education Office under the Axom Sarba Siksha Abhijan Mission has announced a rescheduling of school class timings for all government, provincialised and private schools in the district. item.title: Phones, Ads and Silence: The Price Assam Pays for a Friendly Press
item.description: GUWAHATI: The quiet return of government-issued smartphones by two journalists in Assam has sparked a controversy far larger than the devices themselves.
